definitions.universe: All 11 SPDR sectors; a sector without at least 200 valid observations is ineligible.
definitions.signal_timing: Signals use closes through the rebalance date; new weights earn the next day's return. No lookahead.
definitions.cash: Unallocated weight earns 0%; negative cash represents a margin debit.
definitions.volatility_target: At each monthly rebalance, compute the last 60 daily simple returns of the equal-weight selected-sector basket (1/3 per selected sector; any unallocated remainder is cash with zero return), annualize the sample standard deviation by sqrt(252), set scalar = 0.15 / basket volatility, clip the scalar to [0.50, 1.35], and multiply each selected-sector weight by the scalar. Cash is 1 - gross exposure and may be negative.
definitions.margin_cost: When gross exposure exceeds 1.0, a 5% annual rate is charged monthly on the margin debit: (gross exposure - 1) * 5% / 12.
definitions.cost_model: 10bp applied to one-way sector-weight turnover; cash and margin-debit changes are excluded from trade turnover and charged through the margin cost.
definitions.trade_count: Rebalance dates with non-zero sector turnover.
definitions.win_rate: Share of counted rebalance trades with a positive return over the following holding period.
definitions.max_drawdown_pct: Peak-to-trough drawdown as a negative percentage.
definitions.sharpe_ratio: Annualized daily Sharpe ratio with a 0% risk-free rate; daily returns use sample standard deviation (ddof=1).
definitions.calmar_ratio: CAGR divided by the absolute max drawdown.
definitions.random_baseline: 1000 random monthly schedules. At each OOS rebalance, the baseline samples the same number of positions as the strategy from the same eligible set, without replacement; selected sectors get 1/3 each times the same volatility scalar computed from the baseline's own 60-day equal-weight basket, cash is the residual, and the same 10bp trade and 5% annual margin costs apply. It starts from the strategy's OOS-start weights and uses the same dates.
definitions.calendar_year_metrics: Calendar-year total return and intra-year peak-to-trough drawdown; 2008 is in-sample, 2022 is out-of-sample under the 70/30 split.
